title: Rippers Unmasked — Stylish Action HUD (Fabula Ultima bridge)
description: Registers a Project FU (Fabula Ultima) system adapter with the Stylish Action HUD module: a party HUD tracking HP / MP / IP + condition icons, and an action menu for Attacks, Spells, Skills & Features, Inventory (consumables), Arcana (pulse/dismiss, Arcanist-only), and Guises. Aligned to the SAH community-assets ProjectFU adapter conventions; uses only SAH's public adapter API (no Project FU fork; no SAH code redistributed). A personal-table module — not for redistribution.

requires.reason: This module is a Stylish Action HUD system adapter; it does nothing without SAH.

recommends.reason: Surfaces Arcana (pulse/dismiss) in the action menu.
Surfaces Guises + routes guise actions to its API.

rippers-stylish-hud.note: Registers a 'projectfu' system adapter on Stylish Action HUD via Hooks.once('stylish-action-hud.apiReady'), extending api.BaseSystemAdapter (community-assets convention) with a standalone fallback. Scope: HP/MP/IP + conditions on the party HUD; Attacks/Spells/Skills&Features/Inventory/Arcana(Arcanist-only)/Guises on the action menu. No FU or SAH code redistributed.
